name: Stats Counter
summary: Passive container-responsive metric section that composes a required native list of canonical Stat instances beneath an optional heading.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Titled thematic section or untitled generic root for one complete repeated-metric composition.

anatomy.name: inner
anatomy.description: Container-safe inner wrapper that owns maximum measure and section composition rhythm.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that names the thematic root.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Required target-owned native unordered list that composes the canonical Stat Group class.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item that is also exactly one canonical Stat root; Stat owns all descendant anatomy.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single intrinsic size whose responsive density is private composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Populated passive metric presentation with no authored animation or live-region behavior.

behavior.name: rootSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty title produces a thematic section named by its visible heading; an untitled composition uses a generic root rather than an unnamed section.

behavior.name: canonicalStatComposition
behavior.description: The native list and item wrappers own repeated placement while every item consumes canonical Stat anatomy, typography, formatting metadata, and optional comparison behavior.

behavior.name: targetDataOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own metric records, formatting, units, scope, order, freshness, comparison context, loading, empty, error, stale, and update-announcement policy.

behavior.name: passiveUpdateBoundary
behavior.description: Static metrics are not live regions and S11 performs no count-up. Targets may atomically update formatted child content and separately choose an appropriate user-relevant announcement without exposing intermediate frames.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: An intrinsic repeated layout responds to component inline space without changing, duplicating, or visually reordering metrics.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required metrics omits the root; an empty optional title omits only the heading and selects generic root semantics.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; when present it names the thematic root.

properties.name: metrics
properties.description: One or more target-owned native list-item compositions, each containing one complete canonical Stat with formatted value and visible label.

accessibility: When title is present, render a thematic section associated with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby; use a generic root when title is absent.
Render parallel metrics as a native ul/li list and preserve source order across responsive columns.
Compose exactly one complete canonical Stat per item so every target-formatted value remains adjacent to a visible label and optional comparison.
Include units, scope, and visible direction text needed to understand each metric without relying on punctuation, color, or animation alone.
Do not add range-widget roles, section focus, keyboard behavior, count-up, live-region semantics, observer, timer, or neutral runtime.
If target data changes after render, update the formatted content atomically and choose announcement policy according to user relevance; never announce intermediate animation frames.
Leave locale formatting, business sentiment, data lifecycle, child Stat properties, and target editor behavior with their owning layers.

web.notes: Implemented by conditional titled-section semantics, a native list of canonical Stat compositions, intrinsic container-responsive CSS, strict required-slot omission, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps an optional contextual title and reorderable metric blocks to canonical Stat classes with editor attributes and no component runtime.
